stable.label: native-fluid-projection-v3-ci-pass
stable.note: The active 3D browser route remains the compiler-proven native material/fluid slice. Native body-to-material coupling V2 is promoted on main but isolated from the active browser route. World Weather V1 is a separate CI-passed candidate route until merge and Pages deployment. LIVE_TESTED and DEVICE_TESTED remain false unless actual deployed execution is observed.

active_experience.runtime: from-scratch C++/WASM owns active 3D material/fluid state; JavaScript verifies/transfers native state and drives the from-scratch WebGPU volume renderer
approximations: water remains coarse binary voxel occupancy
ray marching interpolates for presentation only
body/material coupling and world-weather are not yet loaded into this active route

tests: pressure projection reduces reference divergence 16457 to 12340
browser payload equals fresh compiler SHA-256

native_body_mechanics.numeric_model: signed Q16.16 fixed-point at approximately 120 Hz
native_body_mechanics.truth: Node spheres are collision samples, not final creature graphics. This is not a complete six-DOF rigid-body inertia-tensor or FEM tissue solver.

coupling: WATER is counted but not faked as solid
material removal changes later body support
combined material-fluid-body command replay is deterministic
native and zero-import WebAssembly coupled fixtures agree
native_body_material_coupling.truth: This is API-only coupling of the authoritative solvers. There is still no buoyancy, drag, pressure-force, added-mass, lift, wake or body-driven fluid displacement, so swimming is not claimed.

causal_model: temperature-dependent saturation condenses humidity into cloud
cloud condensate above threshold precipitates rain
rain infiltrates soil or becomes mobile surface water
surface water follows local hydraulic head
persistent concentrated discharge diagnoses river cells
tornado cells require simultaneous resolved vorticity, pressure deficit, cloud, rain and wind
browser_contract: browser reconstructs seven committed payload chunks
SHA-256 is verified before WebAssembly instantiation
model version and 192x128 dimensions must match
Math.random is forbidden from generating simulation state
world_weather.truth: This is a deterministic 2D surface atmosphere/hydrology layer, not DNS, LES, mesoscale NWP or a validated tornado forecast model. It does not claim the full 3D material volume has been expanded to 192x128xdepth. Tornado output is a resolved-field diagnostic and is never directly written by a timer or spawn animation.

native_volume_renderer.truth: WebGPU ray marching presents native 3D state; time-driven fake water-normal animation is forbidden; water normals derive from native density gradients and turbidity from native suspended sediment.

active_objective: Promote the 192x128 native atmosphere/hydrology map only after exact C++->WASM payload proof, browser native-state contract, Foundation regression and Pages deployment remain green.
next_gate: After merge, verify World Weather, Foundation, Stable-vs-Lab and both Pages deployment paths. Then feed rainfall/runoff boundary conditions into the native 3D material volume before resuming hydrodynamic body-force work.
next_scientific_blocker: Two-way world coupling: the high-resolution surface weather layer and 3D material/fluid volume are both causal systems, but rainfall/runoff has not yet been injected into the volumetric material state and volumetric evaporation/topography feedback has not yet been returned to the weather layer.
invariants: committed browser WASM must equal fresh compiler output
weather renderer must read native state rather than inventing simulation motion
tornado state cannot be directly timer-spawned
visual interpolation is not simulation resolution
do not call weather validated NWP/tornado forecasting
do not call fluid validated CFD
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
